subject: Cohort onboarding cost-offset request
messages:
From: Sylvia Park <sylvia@bluecanopy.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Request: cohort onboarding cost-offset for BlueCanopy pilot

Hi Priyom & Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move the 20-company accelerator cohort onto Redwood for the onboarding week. Our finance lead flagged that the initial trial credits will be consumed quickly during the first 10 days of heavy ingestion and prototyping.

We wanted to ask whether Redwood can provide a temporary cost-offset (either a trial extension or promotional credit) specifically for the onboarding window to avoid interruptions. Preferably a time-bound credit (2–4 weeks) or a usage cap top-up. We have an approved PO coming from procurement but need confirmation of the commercial handling to include in the SOW.

High level: cohort start 2027-10-03, expected burst ~600–800k tokens/day first week, then taper. Any quick options you can share?

Thanks — Sylvia
Sylvia Park
Head of Partnerships, BlueCanopy Labs
attachment: none

From: priyom.das@redwood.com <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Park <sylvia@bluecanopy.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: cohort onboarding cost-offset for BlueCanopy pilot

Hi Sylvia — great to hear the cohort timing. Quick options we can offer for onboarding bursts: 

- Option A: 3-week trial extension + $10k promotional credit (applies to hosted API only).
- Option B: Conditional top-up credit: 50% of requested uplift (up to $15k) released upfront, remainder released after first-week usage review and a short health check.
- Option C: Short-term reserved throughput for onboarding week (dedicated burst) with a pro-rated charge and $5k credit applied as a one-time offset.

I'll need procurement PO and preferred billing path (invoice vs. marketplace) to model tax/terms. I've attached a quick outline of the credit structure so procurement has text to include in the SOW.

Next steps: if you want to go with B (recommended for larger bursts), send the PO and I'll loop in finance for sign-off; we can also push a fast DocuSign for credit terms.

Best,
Priyom Das
Partnerships Manager — Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
attachment: cohort-credit-outline-v1.pdf (PDF, 68KB)

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: BlueCanopy cohort credit request — recommendation

Priyom / Laura,

Quick note: BlueCanopy is strategic for our Q4 accelerator placements and runway. Recommend approving Option B (50% upfront up to $15k, remainder after usage review) with a condition: PO on file and HubSpot deal stage moved to "Pilot - Contract Sent." Finance okayed discretionary promo credits up to $15k for startup/accelerator cohorts under our program budget.

If Laura agrees, I can prepare the credit memo and trigger the DocuSign flow. Also propose a 2-week post-onboarding usage review checkpoint to validate continued capacity needs.

Karthik
Director, Growth — Startup Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Sylvia Park <sylvia@bluecanopy.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@bluecanopy.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: cohort onboarding cost-offset for BlueCanopy pilot

Thanks — Option B works for us. I've attached the PO (PO_7842.pdf) — it references the onboarding SOW and our internal billing code. We prefer invoice path rather than marketplace charge. Can you confirm timeline for applying the upfront credit and whether the credit will be visible on the invoice?

Also, procurement needs the exact credit wording to reference in their SOW. Happy to take whatever you prepared in the outline and include it verbatim.

Sylvia
attachment: PO_7842.pdf (PDF, 110KB)

From: priyom.das@redwood.com <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Park <sylvia@bluecanopy.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: cohort onboarding cost-offset for BlueCanopy pilot

Sylvia — thanks for the PO. Confirming we can do Option B as requested. Final commercial notes: 

- Upfront credit: 50% of the approved uplift, capped at $15,000, will be applied as a bill credit on the first invoice following cohort activation. The credit will appear as a line item "Promotional onboarding credit — BlueCanopy Labs".
- Remaining credit: remaining 50% will be applied after the 7-day usage review and a short check-in call. If the cohort usage is within expected ranges we apply the remainder as an invoice credit; if not, we invoice any overages per standard rates.
- Timeline: we need DocuSign approval on the attached credit terms by EOD 2027-09-16 to ensure credits are in place before the 2027-10-03 cohort start.

I've attached the final credit terms for signature and included the HubSpot deal link and a DocuSign placeholder. Karthik/Laura — please confirm sign-off on the terms so I can send DocuSign to Sylvia.

Best,
Priyom
